Build a Fruit Ninja style slicing game. Fruit of at least four shapes and colors
are tossed up from below in arcs and fall back out of view. Hold the left mouse
button and drag to slice; the slice is the cursor's path between frames, so a
fast swipe must cut every fruit it crosses. Sliced fruit splits into two halves
that fly apart with spin plus a burst of juice particles. Bombs are tossed among
the fruit, and slicing one ends the game, as does letting three fruit fall
unsliced. One point per fruit, with a combo bonus for three or more in one swipe.
Draw a blade trail while dragging. Show score, misses and a game over screen.
